# Saints by Candlelight: bedtime stories of saints, angels and patriarchs

> Free bedtime story podcast of Catholic and Orthodox saints, angels and patriarchs: lighthearted, faithful, 30 to 60 minute episodes with full scripts and an honest note on what is history and what is legend.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
